senses.sense_definition: To surround, cover, or submerge completely.

examples.text: The rising flood waters began to <w>engulf</w> the small village during the night.

target_lang_translations.es: Las crecientes aguas de la inundación comenzaron a <w>inundar</w> la pequeña aldea durante la noche.

target_lang_translations.fr: Une fumée épaisse a commencé à <w>envahir</w> le bâtiment, rendant la sortie impossible à voir.

target_lang_translations.cs: Hustý kouř začal budovu <w>zahálovat</w>, takže nebylo možné spatřit východ.

target_lang_definitions.tr: Bir şeyi tamamen çevrelemek, örtmek veya su altında bırakmak.

target_lang_definitions.ru: Полностью окружить, покрыть или погрузить что-либо под воду или другую среду.
target_lang_definitions.es: Rodear, cubrir o sumergir completamente algo o a alguien.

target_lang_definitions.de: Etwas vollständig umgeben, einhüllen oder überfluten.
target_lang_definitions.fr: Entourer, recouvrir ou submerger complètement (par de l'eau, de la fumée, des flammes, etc.).

senses.sense_definition: To overwhelm or consume someone or something completely.

examples.text: The earthquake caused the road to crack and <w>engulf</w> the passing vehicles into the earth.

target_lang_translations.tr: Deprem yolun çatlamasına ve yoldan geçen araçların yerin içine <w>gömülmesine</w> neden oldu.

target_lang_translations.it: Il terremoto ha causato la spaccatura della strada e ha <w>inghiottito</w> i veicoli in transito nella terra.

target_lang_definitions.tr: Bir şeyi derin bir uçuruma veya boşluğa atmak ya da içine çekilmesine neden olmak.
target_lang_definitions.nl: Iets in een diepe afgrond of leegte werpen of laten vallen.
